description: Adaptive Workout Coach — a guided 30-minute workout app anyone can follow, even with no routine or experience (Node.js + Express + SQLite). Server-backed session timer with full lifecycle (start/pause/resume/clear/complete/expiry), per-exercise checklists, demo videos, weekly gym calendar with 3x/week tracking, and a foundation/accessory exercise-block structure built to grow into personalized full-body training.
name: adaptive-workout-coach
